title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct final answer of approximately 1 ton per cm^3.

title: Energy Density Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state and apply the radiant energy density equation u = 4σT^4/c.

title: Mass-Energy Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the mass-energy relation to derive the mass of black body radiation per unit volume.

title: Unit Conversion
description: Optional Criteria: The student should convert units correctly from kg/m^3 to ton/cm^3.

title: Calculation Accuracy
description: Important Criteria: The calculations leading to the final answer must be accurate and correctly executed.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should not contain sign mistakes in the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the calculations.
